colour_model: One common pointwise luminance lift for every active texture and baked vertex colour. Add the luminance increase equally to RGB, preserving absolute linear channel differences rather than amplifying low-light chromatic noise. Preserve alpha, pixel positions and renderer background. No spatial blur, local histogram or generative relighting.
scope: Reversible display-only shadow visibility derivative. No pose, mesh, UV, source photograph or navigation changes. Zero-valued colour and unobserved empty space are not reconstructed.
